prompt: Build a web app that lets freelancers create, send and track invoices and accept card payments. Take it from requirements through design, backend, frontend, payments, testing, security, privacy, deployment, documentation and launch.

subtasks.query: gather requirements and write user stories for invoicing
user research interviews with freelancers
wireframes and information architecture for the invoice editor
visual UI design of the dashboard
backend API design and service architecture
database schema for invoices and payments with query tuning
build the React frontend
integrate Stripe card payments and billing
automated unit and end-to-end tests
security penetration test of the web app
GDPR privacy review of customer data
CI/CD pipeline and cloud deployment
monitoring, reliability and on-call incident response
user documentation and help center articles
launch marketing campaign and content

prompt: Launch a mobile fitness tracking app on iOS and Android, from market research and app store listing through to release, test automation, privacy review and ongoing feedback.

subtasks.query: market research on fitness app trends and competitors
analyze app store reviews and user feedback themes
UI screens for workout tracking
build the cross-platform mobile app
mobile app release to App Store and Play Console
app store listing keywords and screenshot optimization
mobile app test automation on real devices
backend sync API for workouts and user accounts
privacy compliance for health data
prioritize the feature backlog for the next sprint
launch announcement social posts and content

Unity multiplayer networking and matchmaking
